title: Ebru marbling
summary: Float drops of paint on a tray of thickened water, draw a needle through them to pull flowers, and lay a sheet of paper on top to take the pattern.
howToPlay: The pattern in the frame shows what to make.
Tap the tray to drop the colour the ring shows.
Draw the comb or the needle along the lit lines.
rules: Each new drop pushes the earlier drops outward, so the order matters.
Three stars for 88 or more, two stars for 65 and one star for 40.
Doing nothing scores nothing. Watch and learn plays a whole round for you.
heritageNote: Ebru is the Turkish art of marbling paper. Colours are floated on a tray of thickened water, drawn into flowers and waves with a needle or a comb, and printed by laying a sheet of paper on top.
